name: Red Spider: Vengeance Remastered donation ver.
detailed_description:
You can read all routes in the free trial version (regular edition)!

You can read all stories in the free trial version of this game. Please purchase the donation version only if you wish to obtain Steam achievements.


About the Game

Set in Hong Kong in 2014, this hard-boiled visual novel tells the story of a former hitwoman whose husband, the leader of a criminal organization, is brutally attacked. To avenge him, she teams up with trusted allies to confront the ruthless perpetrators. It's a gripping experience filled with deep love and homage to classic Hong Kong noir films.

This game is a profound visual novel centered on the revenge saga of its protagonist, the solitary empress Yvet. Yet, beyond this fierce destiny, there are multiple different "truths" that can only be reached through your "choices" as the player.

This game features six distinct endings, each focusing on a specific character with whom Yvet has forged a deep bond.

These endings are not merely variations of a conclusion. They offer an opportunity to uncover "another truth" that delves into the core of the story from the perspective of the character with whom Yvet has strengthened her bond.

By playing through all the endings, you will not only discover various facets of Yvet as a woman but also gain a complete understanding of the complex motives of those around her, and the "full picture" of the entire Red Spider narrative.

Whose side will Yvet take, and what conclusion will her revenge story reach—?

Embark on this journey to unveil all truths with your own hands.

This is a Steam exclusive donation version to support development.

The donation version has premium benefits open from the start and will support Steam achievements.

The free version does not support Steam Achievements, but premium benefits will be opened by answering the survey.

Premium bonus: liner notes and production notes

This is a remastered version of "Red Spider:Vengeance" a full-voice Hong Kong noir visual novel game originally released in 2014.

The theme song is composed by Yasunori Shiono, known for his work on the SFC "Estpolis Denki" (Lufia) series.

Story

The protagonist, Yvet, is a former assassin who received training at the assassination organization "Spiderweb" in her youth. After leaving the organization for personal reasons, she became the wife of Francis, the leader of the Red Flower Society operating in Kowloon.

One night, Francis is attacked at a nightclub and is diagnosed with no hope of regaining consciousness. Sensing an opportunity for succession, ambitious executives begin to scheme, while the Hong Kong Police plan to intervene in the investigation. As acting chairwoman, Yvet must navigate these power struggles, commanding her bodyguards and trusted detective to identify the mastermind behind her husband's assassination.

Game Features

Set in the world of Hong Kong noir, this story unfolds within the ruthless criminal underworld. Your choices influence the relationships between characters, leading to 6 different endings.

Characters

Yvet

The protagonist. After her parents were murdered in her childhood, she was taken in by an assassination organization and trained in various assassination techniques. Following her escape, she was sheltered by Yeung Kwun, the former chairman of the Red Flower Society, and became the wife of his son, Francis. She vows to find and avenge her husband's attacker.

Francis

Yvet's husband. He had pursued a legitimate career as a lawyer, but after his father Yeung Kwun's death, he reluctantly took over as chairman of the Red Flower Society at Yvet's request to quell the succession chaos. He was aware of Yvet's past and made it a condition of his succession that she become his wife. The attack on him reignites the succession struggle.

The Ghost

The Red Flower Society chairman's bodyguard. He has served the family since Yeung Kwun's time. Highly loyal to the organization, he views Yvet with suspicion as she assumes the role of acting chairwoman. To strengthen Yvet's security amidst the succession dispute, he calls in the Luk brothers.

Lai

Yvet's old acquaintance and a detective. He was formerly a police officer. Yvet once saved his life, and out of gratitude, he assists in investigating the attack. He is wary of the Ghost, who seems to be hiding something from Yvet.

Luk
Yvet's security detail, summoned by the Ghost. He possesses a trained physique, calm judgment, and high combat capabilities. However, he is less adept with modern IT technology and relies solely on his younger brother, Shawn, for information gathering. He was once part of the same assassination organization as Yvet.

Shawn
Luk's younger brother. While not highly skilled in combat, he excels at information gathering using the internet. Cracking servers with weak security and developing information-gathering viruses are second nature to him.

Dog Head

A Red Flower Society executive. He was a hot-headed, belligerent fighter who commanded strong trust within the organization. However, he fell under suspicion of plotting Francis's assassination upon the former chairman's death, which subsequently diminished his standing within the Red Flower Society. He has a son named Johnny with his deceased wife.

Playtime

Multiple Choices / 6 Routes Total / Approximately 7-8 hours (Just over 1 hour per route)

Features

The scenario for this game was written with specific actual Hong Kong movie actors in mind, imagining them in these roles. Details on which actors inspired which characters are included in the game's "Cyclopedia."
